query: Based on a True Story... is an album by which country music star, with the single My Eyes?

retrieved_context: Based on a True Story...: Based on a True Story… is the eighth studio album by American country music artist Blake Shelton.  It was released on March 26, 2013 via Warner Bros.  Records and debuted at #3 with a career best for Shelton at nearly 200,000 sold.  The album became the ninth best-selling album of 2013 in the US, earning Shelton a Platinum certification by the RIAA on September 30, 2013.  In 2016, "Based on a True Story…" was certified double-platinum by the RIAA.

My Eyes (Blake Shelton song): "My Eyes" is a song recorded by American country music artist Blake Shelton featuring Gwen Sebastian.  It was released in April 2014 as the fifth single from his seventh studio album, "Based on a True Story...".  The song was written by Andrew Dorff, Tommy Lee James and Josh Osborne.
